finance_account_linking_credit_identity_.description: Heading after the backend confirms Experian identity verification, while the first credit report is still being prepared. This does not mean the report or score is ready.

finance_account_linking_credit_provider_.description: Name of the connected credit bureau in the Credit score tab of ChatGPT Personal Finance's Connect finances dialog. Experian is a brand name; do not translate it. Short row title above the user's credit score.

finance_account_linking_credit_report_ch.description: Action to check whether a pending first credit report is ready after automatic status checks stop. This checks the server and does not restart identity verification.

finance_account_linking_credit_report_fa.defaultMessage: Nepodarilo sa nám získať vašu úverovú správu od spoločnosti Experian.
finance_account_linking_credit_report_fa.description: Body message in the Credit score tab of the Connect finances dialog when Experian confirms activation of the initial credit report failed. Identity verification succeeded. No retry, new verification, or bureau-contact action is offered; the user can close the dialog. Preserve Experian as the company name.

finance_account_linking_credit_report_pr.description: Neutral progress message while the first Experian credit report is pending after identity verification. Also labels the activity indicator. Do not imply a failure, a percentage, or a completion time.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_cha.defaultMessage: Zistiť viac o mojom kreditnom skóre
finance_account_linking_credit_score_cha.description: Short button label on the connected Experian screen in the Finance account-linking sheet, shown after the user's stored credit score is available. Selecting it sends a credit-score question in a Finance chat so the user can discuss their score.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_cha.defaultMessage: Zobraz mi widget s mojím kreditným skóre a pomôž mi pochopiť, čo moje skóre znamená.
finance_account_linking_credit_score_cha.description: Complete user message submitted to a Finance chat only after the user selects Explore my credit score on the connected Experian screen. It asks ChatGPT to display the user's stored score as an interactive widget and explain it. Translate as a natural first-person request; no personal credit data is included.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_con.description: Screen-reader status for the connected credit-bureau row in the Credit score tab of ChatGPT Personal Finance's Connect finances dialog. Also shown below the bureau name while a numeric score is not available. The connection does not need another identity verification.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_des.defaultMessage: Over svoju identitu cez Experian a pripoj svoje úverové skóre.
finance_account_linking_credit_score_des.description: Explanation that Experian verifies the user's identity before connecting their credit score.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_exp.defaultMessage: Prepoj svoje úverové skóre so službou Experian
finance_account_linking_credit_score_exp.description: Heading above the benefits of connecting a VantageScore 3.0 credit score from Experian in ChatGPT Personal Finance. Experian is a brand name; do not translate it.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_get.description: Action that starts Experian's identity-verification flow to connect the user's credit score.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_goa.defaultMessage: Prehľady prispôsobené tebe podľa tvojho skóre a financií
finance_account_linking_credit_score_goa.description: Supporting copy explaining that credit score and financial information inform personalized insights.
Benefit title for personalized financial insights in the Experian connection screen.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_lea.defaultMessage: Viac informácií o kredite v ChatGPT
finance_account_linking_credit_score_lea.description: Link below the Experian connection action to information about credit in ChatGPT.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_mon.defaultMessage: Získavaj mesačné aktualizácie a upozornenia z monitorovania
finance_account_linking_credit_score_mon.description: Supporting copy for credit score updates and monitoring alerts in the Experian connection screen.
Benefit title for credit score updates and monitoring alerts in the Experian connection screen.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_no_.defaultMessage: Kontrola tvojho kreditu neovplyvní tvoje skóre
finance_account_linking_credit_score_no_.description: Reassurance below the Experian connection action that checking a credit score does not affect it.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_rep.defaultMessage: Získaj svoje skóre, kľúčové faktory a úplnú správu
finance_account_linking_credit_score_rep.description: Supporting copy for the full credit report benefit in the Experian connection screen.
Benefit title explaining that connecting a credit score from Experian includes access to the full report.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_sum.description: Compact subtitle below Experian in the connected Credit score tab of ChatGPT Personal Finance's Connect finances dialog. The score placeholder is the user's actual credit score, already formatted as a localized whole number. Keep this descriptive and neutral; do not add a rating or imply that the score has changed.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_tit.description: Heading and action accessibility label for connecting a credit score.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_una.defaultMessage: Overenie kreditu momentálne nie je k dispozícii.
finance_account_linking_credit_score_una.description: Message shown while shared Finance cannot safely start credit verification.

finance_account_linking_credit_score_ver.description: Screen-reader label announced while credit score verification is running.

finance_account_linking_credit_status_lo.defaultMessage: Nepodarilo sa nám načítať tvoj úverový stav.
finance_account_linking_credit_status_lo.description: Message shown when shared Finance cannot read the account's credit status.
Screen-reader label announced while shared Finance loads the account's credit status.

finance_account_linking_credit_status_re.description: Action that retries a failed credit status read without starting verification.
Screen-reader label for the action that retries a failed credit status read.

finance_account_linking_credit_update_ac.description: Button opening the appropriate app store to update the installed ChatGPT mobile app.

finance_account_linking_credit_update_de.description: Explanation that the installed ChatGPT mobile app must be updated. Shown with an Update ChatGPT button in Finance.

finance_account_linking_credit_update_ti.description: Generic heading asking a ChatGPT mobile app user to update before continuing. Shown when Finance credit verification requires newer app support.

finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.defaultMessage: Nepodarilo sa nám overiť niektoré tvoje údaje. Zavolaj, prosím, do spoločnosti Experian na číslo 1 (800) 493-1058 a požiadaj o pomoc s opravou svojich osobných údajov.
finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.description: Body message in the Finances credit verification recovery screen only when the backend confirms that the user needs help from Experian to correct personal information. Also shown when reopening that failed connection. Personal information dispute means asking Experian to correct their identity information. Preserve the Experian company name and phone number 1 (800) 493-1058. The Contact Experian button below opens its existing help webpage.

Button in the Finances credit tab after a confirmed identity-verification failure. Opens Experian’s contact help page in the browser without starting another verification. Keep Experian as the company name.
Action that resumes an unfinished identity verification.

finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.defaultMessage: Overenie sa nepodarilo dokončiť. Skús to znova.
finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.description: Generic retry message when verification cannot be completed; does not imply identity rejection.

finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.defaultMessage: Platnosť relácie overenia vypršala. Skús to znova a spusti novú reláciu.
finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.description: Message shown when the backend confirms that the verification session expired.

finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.defaultMessage: Nepodarilo sa nám overiť tvoju identitu. Požiadaj Experian o pomoc.
finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.description: Experian contact guidance after an authoritative identity-verification failure.

finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.defaultMessage: Tvoje overenie nie je dokončené. Pokračuj, keď budeš pripravený/-á.
finance_account_linking_credit_verificat.description: Message after cancellation or when the backend requires further verification.
Action that starts enrollment again after an expired session or an interruption; not shown for a confirmed identity-verification failure.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_cash.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi manuálne sledovať hotovostný účet. Pýtaj sa vždy jednu krátku otázku na jeho názov, typ (bežný alebo sporiaci), aktuálny zostatok a v prípade nejasností aj menu. Inštitúcia je voliteľná. Po mojej odpovedi ho ulož do finančnej pamäte ako samostatný účet.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_cash.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Cash manual-account category. Ask one short question at a time for the account name, checking or savings subtype, and current balance; the institution is optional and currency is needed only if unclear. Save a separate account as a financial memory only after the user answers. Preserve the first-person request.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_insurance.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi manuálne sledovať poistku. Najprv sa opýtaj, či má skutočnú peňažnú alebo odkupnú hodnotu, nielen plnenie pre prípad smrti. Potom sa po jednej stručne pýtaj na jej názov, hodnotu a v prípade nejasnosti aj menu. Až keď odpoviem, ulož ju do finančnej pamäte.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_insurance.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Insurance manual-account category. First confirm the policy has actual cash or surrender value, not merely a death benefit, then ask one short question at a time for its name and cash value; ask for currency only if unclear. Save a financial memory only after the user answers. Preserve the first-person request.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_investmen.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi manuálne sledovať investičný účet. Pýtaj sa vždy jednu krátku otázku na jeho názov, typ, celkový zostatok a v prípade nejasnosti aj menu. Po mojej odpovedi ho ulož ako finančnú spomienku pre samostatný investičný účet, nie ako investíciu ani všeobecné aktívum.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_investmen.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Investments manual-account category. Ask one short question at a time for the account name, investment account subtype, and total balance; ask for currency only if unclear. After the user answers, save a separate investment account as a financial memory, not as an individual holding or generic asset. Preserve the first-person request.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_loans.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi ručne evidovať pôžičku. Pýtaj sa ma vždy jednou krátkou otázkou na jej názov, typ, kladnú dlžnú sumu a v prípade nejasnosti aj menu. Veriteľ je nepovinný. Po mojej odpovedi ju ulož do finančnej pamäte.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_loans.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Loans manual-account category. Ask one short question at a time for the loan name, loan type, and positive amount owed; the lender is optional and currency is needed only if unclear. Save a financial memory only after the user answers. Preserve the first-person request.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_other_ass.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi manuálne zaevidovať majetok. Pýtaj sa vždy jednou krátkou otázkou na jeho názov, typ, odhadovanú hodnotu a v prípade nejasností aj menu. Po mojej odpovedi ho ulož do finančnej pamäte.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_other_ass.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Other assets manual-account category. Ask one short question at a time for the asset name, asset type, and estimated value; ask for currency only if unclear. Save a financial memory only after the user answers. Preserve the first-person request.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_other_deb.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi ručne zaevidovať dlh. Pýtaj sa ma po jednej krátkej otázke na jeho názov, či ide o kreditnú kartu, kladnú dlžnú sumu a menu, ak nie je jasná. Veriteľ je voliteľný. Keď odpoviem, ulož ho do finančnej pamäte.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_other_deb.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Other debt manual-account category. Ask one short question at a time for the debt name, credit-card or other debt subtype, and positive amount owed; the creditor is optional and currency is needed only if unclear. Save a financial memory only after the user answers. Preserve the first-person request.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_real_esta.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi manuálne evidovať nehnuteľnosti. Pýtaj sa vždy jednu krátku otázku na názov nehnuteľnosti, typ, odhadovanú hodnotu a v prípade nejasnosti aj menu. Po mojej odpovedi to ulož ako finančnú spomienku.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_real_esta.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Real estate manual-account category. Ask one short question at a time for the property name, property type, and estimated value; ask for currency only if unclear. Save a financial memory only after the user answers. Preserve the first-person request.

finance_manual_accounts_prompt_vehicle.defaultMessage: Pomôž mi manuálne sledovať vozidlo. Pýtaj sa po jednej krátkej otázke na jeho názov, typ, odhadovanú hodnotu a v prípade nejasnosti aj menu. Po mojej odpovedi ho ulož so finančnej pamäte.
finance_manual_accounts_prompt_vehicle.description: User message automatically sent to ChatGPT when a user selects the Vehicle manual-account category. Ask one short question at a time for the vehicle name, vehicle type, and estimated value; ask for currency only if unclear. Save a financial memory only after the user answers. Preserve the first-person request.
